title: Pushup position guide lines
description:
Add two horizontal guide lines on the tracking screen to help users visualize valid pushup positions:

- **Lower line**: Shows the threshold where a movement counts as reaching the 'down' position (elbow ≤90°)
- **Upper line**: Shows the threshold where returning to 'up' position completes a full rep (elbow ≥160°)

Line specifications:
- Thin green lines spanning ~2/3 of screen width, horizontally centered
- Dynamic positioning based on detected shoulder height during the workout
- Lines flash/change color when the user crosses them
- Toggle button (matching FAB style) to show/hide the guide lines
- Visibility preference persisted via SharedPreferences
close_reason: All tasks completed - pushup position guide lines feature implemented

title: Create GuideLinesPainter widget
description:
Create a CustomPainter widget that draws two horizontal guide lines:
- Lines should be thin (2-3px) and green
- Each line spans ~2/3 of screen width, horizontally centered
- Accept Y-coordinates for upper and lower line positions
- Support color property for flash feedback
close_reason: Created GuideLinesPainter CustomPainter with thin green lines, 2/3 width centered

title: Calculate dynamic line positions from shoulder landmarks
description:
Calculate the Y-positions for guide lines based on detected shoulder height:
- Lower line: Y-position when shoulders are at 'down' position (calibrated from elbow angle ≤90°)
- Upper line: Y-position when shoulders are at 'up' position (calibrated from elbow angle ≥160°)
- Update positions dynamically as pose is detected
- Handle cases where landmarks are not visible
close_reason: Implemented dynamic shoulder position tracking with smoothing and calibration
